about: A long prompt is typed into Claude's terminal as a paste, and Claude 2.1.283 records it between <pasted_content id="…"> lines after a blank line (the row is a real 2.1.283 transcript line). The prompt row reads as the text the person sent.

prompt.text:
Call the AskUserQuestion tool exactly once, now, with these four questions and nothing else first. Q1 header "Database", question "Which database should the service use?", single select, options: "SQLite" (description "One file, no server"), "Postgres" (description "A server, more features"). Q2 header "Checks", question "Which checks should run before merge?", multiSelect true, options: "Lint", "Unit tests", "Integration tests". Q3 header "Layout", question "Which config layout do you prefer?", single select, options "Flat" with preview "port = 8080
host = localhost" and "Nested" with preview "[server]
port = 8080
host = localhost". Q4 header "Name", question "What should the service be called?", single select, options "api", "backend". After the answers arrive, repeat each answer back in one short line per question and stop.
